notes: Formalization reference for Gödel's 1970 variant (#135), BSD license. Pinned as two web snapshots of the AFP's HTML renderings, AFP-NOTES-GOEDEL-HOML1-THY (GoedelVariantHOML1.thy) and AFP-NOTES-GOEDEL-HOMLINHOL-THY (HOMLinHOL.thy), because the source kinds are frozen (AGENTS.md invariant 18) and a text witness must be XML. The rendered theories are those of the AFP release tarball afp-Notes_On_Goedels_Ontological_Argument-2026-02-06.tar.gz (sha256 ca835ed35e57fed12639e3f3d819d3f43bfa5af661640d2472c7facbd94a0b39; GoedelVariantHOML1.thy sha256 46bb1b4dd35afaf984057354e82ae0c50a27f7e37e86623e202d0413e3cc1f8a, Git blob 99e10af3a7eba8d71b439aedcbac274c1d3b7502; HOMLinHOL.thy sha256 f738ba1099a1c79a14f010ec6b5aa2663fa1a879354f50a51da6f1b4e0a9c0ee, Git blob 5a3d68d96c8bcfaab7e0326c3c6b711ca7da3929), which was the current release when pinned. The pages live under browser_info/current/ and are regenerated by each AFP release; no Wayback capture is recorded, so the snapshots must be re-pinned (and their claims re-read) when a release changes them. The theory cites Figure 6 of the associated article (Monatshefte für Mathematik) and is a secondary witness for Gödel's 1970 manuscript, which is not pinned. Claims attribute what the AFP theory states. They do not say what Gödel intended or how the manuscript developed, and a proof of a theorem of the theory does not establish that.
